settings.title: Who is this for?
settings.content:
• At-Home Skinthusiast - consumers looking to elevate their skincare regimen
  • Licensed Estheticians & Spa Professionals looking to expand their microcurrent services.
  • Facial Specialists wanting to integrate ancient massage techniques with modern technology.
  • Holistic Practitioners seeking Ayurvedic-inspired tools for advanced facial rejuvenation.
  • Boutique Spas & Medspas offering sculpting, detox, or anti-aging treatments.

settings.title: How to use it?
settings.content:
1. Pre-Treatment: Cleanse client’s skin and apply a conductive gel or serum.
  2. Setup: Connect each Gua Sha to the MyoLift™ device via lead wires.
  3. Application:
  • Use both tools simultaneously for balanced sculpting movements.
  • Follow established MyoLift facial protocols or integrate into your spa’s signature treatments.
  1. Post-Treatment: Clean with a soft cloth and sanitize appropriately before next use.

settings.title: Benefits
settings.content:
• Dual-Hand Application: Perform symmetrical facial treatments for faster and more precise sessions.
  • Boosted Treatment Efficacy: Deliver microcurrent through the Gua Sha tools for deeper muscle stimulation and product penetration.
  • Visible Facial Contouring: Helps lift sagging skin and sculpt cheekbones and jawline naturally.
  • Lymphatic Drainage & Detox: Stimulates lymph flow to reduce puffiness and improve skin clarity.
  • Relaxation & Tension Relief: Releases fascia and relaxes facial muscles, enhancing client comfort.
  • Holistic Appeal: Integrates Ayurvedic wellness into advanced skincare routines, aligning with holistic spa offerings.

settings.title: Product Features
settings.content:
• Material: Handcrafted from authentic Kansa alloy for optimal conductivity and skin compatibility.
  • Device Compatibility: Works with all MyoLift™ devices including Mini, QT+, and Triwave.
  • Ergonomic Design: Sculpted for both large and small muscle groups—perfect for customized treatments.
  • Durability & Hygiene: Easy to sanitize between sessions; naturally antimicrobial surface.

settings.heading: Why You'll Love it
settings.section_content: The MyoLift™ Gua Sha is thin and perfectly designed to sculpt big and small facial muscles and relax any stressed or hardened tissue that are otherwise harder to target. This tool can be used with any MyoLift™ device for a combined fascia release, tension release, relaxing and energizing microcurrent facial.Gua Sha tool is commonly used for tension release and facial massages. When a conductive Gua Sha is used in conjunction with microcurrent, it enhances the results by combining the benefits of both Gua Sha and Microcurrent and saves time in doing the facial treatments. Additionally the benefits are deeper and long lasting.

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.title1: What is the MyoLift™ Gua Sha made of?
settings.text1: It’s crafted from Kansa, an Ayurvedic metal alloy of copper and tin known for its therapeutic and antimicrobial properties.
settings.title2: How does this differ from a traditional Gua Sha tool?
settings.text2: Unlike traditional tools, this Gua Sha conducts microcurrent when connected to a MyoLift™ device, enhancing its lifting, sculpting, and lymphatic drainage effects.
settings.title3: Is it safe to use daily?
settings.text3: Yes, it’s gentle enough for regular use—2–5 times a week is ideal, depending on your skin’s needs and sensitivity.
settings.title4: Can I use it without a MyoLift™ device?
settings.text4: You can use it manually, but pairing it with a MyoLift™ device significantly amplifies its benefits through microcurrent stimulation.
settings.title5: What areas can I treat with it?
settings.text5: The ergonomic shape is designed to treat both large areas (like cheeks and jawline) and smaller zones (like under the eyes and brow area).
settings.title6: How do I clean and care for the tool?
settings.text6: Wipe it with a soft, damp cloth after each use. Avoid harsh chemicals to maintain the integrity of the Kansa metal.
